description: This PHP source file defines the MembershipDao class, which manages data access operations for Membership entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and querying memberships, often utilizing Doctrine ORM features such as query builders and pagination.

classes.name: MembershipDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Membership entities, providing methods to perform CRUD operations and queries related to memberships within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Persists a Membership entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getExistingMembershipIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of membership IDs that already exist in the database from a provided list.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Fetches a Membership entity by its name after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Returns a list of memberships based on search filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getMembershipListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for paginated membership query results based on search filters.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Returns the count of memberships matching the search filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple memberships identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks if a membership name already exists in the database.
